# DESeq code sample-- comparing Cylindrotheca in t=0 to N-amended end members
```{r}
# read in raw count data for whole assembly (available on Zenodo)
setwd("your_local_path")
read.csv("all_2015_tax_euk_egg_numreads.csv")

# make df for DEseq
deseq_cylindro_df <- all_2015_tax_euk_egg_numreads %>%
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ grepl("Cylindrotheca", ., ignore.case = TRUE))) %>% # there should be 13820 unique cylindro contigs
  dplyr::select(c(1,51:70)) %>% #only keep contig ID and amendment columns
  rename_with(~ sub("^.", "", .), starts_with("X")) %>% #remove the extra 'X' from data columns
  filter(!is.na(Contig_ID)) %>%
  group_by(Contig_ID) %>%  # Group by the column of interest
  filter(row_number()==1) %>% # make sure there are no duplicate contigs
  ungroup() %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames('Contig_ID')

deseq_cylindro_df_test <- deseq_cylindro_df %>%
    filter(!if_all(c(1:20), ~ . <= 1)) #remove any contigs with less than 1 across all samples -- ran this as a test through deseq, got the same number of DE genes

# make column metadata file for DESeq
Col_d <- data.frame(c(rep("2pm_R",3), rep("minus_N", 2), rep("control", 3), rep("DSW", 3), rep("plus_P", 3), rep("plus_N", 3), rep("minus_P", 3)))
col.names <- c('2pm_R1_7_26','2pm_R2_7_26','2pm_R3_7_26','minus_N_2','minus_N_3','control_1','control_2','control_3','DSW_1','DSW_2','DSW_3','plus_P_1','plus_P_2','plus_P_3','plus_N_1','plus_N_2','plus_N_3','minus_P_1','minus_P_2','minus_P_3')
colnames(Col_d)[1] = "Treatment"
rownames(Col_d) <- col.names
Col_d$Treatment <- as.factor(Col_d$Treatment)

# Making the DDS files for DESeq
deseq_cylindro_df_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(deseq_cylindro_df),
                              colData = Col_d,
                              design = ~ Treatment)

# create dds for running DESeq
deseq_cylindro_df_dds_3 <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(deseq_cylindro_df_dds, type="ratio")
deseq_cylindro_df_dds_2 <- DESeq2::estimateDispersions(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_3)
deseq_cylindro_df_dds_1 <- nbinomWaldTest(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_2)
resultsNames(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_1)

# in situ vs plus N DESeq run
cylindro_insitu_plus_N <- results(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_1, c("Treatment", "2pm_R", "plus_N"))
cylindro_insitu_plus_N_df <- cylindro_insitu_plus_N %>%
  as.data.frame()  %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Contig_ID") %>% # make the row names (which are the gene names) into column 1
  select(c(1,3,7)) %>% # only keep the results you need
  rename_with(.fn = ~ paste0(.x, "_insitu_vs_plus_N"), .cols = c(2:3)) #rename the results by comparison

# in situ vs minus_P DESeq run
cylindro_insitu_minus_P <- results(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_1, c("Treatment", "2pm_R", "minus_P"))
cylindro_insitu_minus_P_df <- cylindro_insitu_minus_P %>%
  as.data.frame()  %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Contig_ID") %>%
  select(c(1,3,7)) %>%
  rename_with(.fn = ~ paste0(.x, "_insitu_vs_minus_P"), .cols = c(2:3))

# in situ vs DSW DESeq run
cylindro_insitu_DSW <- results(deseq_cylindro_df_dds_1, c("Treatment", "2pm_R", "DSW"))
cylindro_insitu_DSW_df <- cylindro_insitu_DSW %>%
  as.data.frame()  %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Contig_ID") %>%
  select(c(1,3,7)) %>%
  rename_with(.fn = ~ paste0(.x, "_insitu_vs_DSW"), .cols = c(2:3))

# make a df with all results to look through
cylindro_insitu_deseq <- cylindro_insitu_plus_N_df %>%
  left_join(cylindro_insitu_minus_P_df, by = "Contig_ID") %>%
  left_join(cylindro_insitu_DSW_df, by = "Contig_ID")

```
